verdict.rationale: Outlook exposes a documented REST API through Microsoft Graph, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. Graph Explorer and the OData query-parameter docs are adjacent tooling, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
